name: Lane-Metro Youth Corps summer crew
org: Looking Glass Community Services (Riverfront School and Career Center)
what_you_do: Summer crew members pull out invasive plants. They gather and plant native seeds and plants, build small things and take down fences. They also help care for park sites.
who_can_apply: Applicants ages 16 to 21 who can work in a group of young adults from different backgrounds.
pay_detail: Paid. Hourly rate not stated on the page.
deadline_text: Current-year dates not posted on the page. The page says the crew is a 9 week program at 32 hours a week, and to fill out the interest form for an application.
how_to_apply: Fill out the interest form on the Lane-Metro Youth Corps page. You get more info and a form to apply.
notes: The program page has no date (it has a 2021 example). Confirm the current ages, pay and dates with Looking Glass before you apply. School credit is available. It runs with the Oregon Youth Conservation Corps. Oregon BOLI does not give work permits to minors ages 14 to 17. Employers need a certificate to hire minors.
